visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a close-up of a person's hands holding a small, round, black accessory bag featuring a gold-toned logo on the front. The setting is the interior of a car, with light blue denim jeans visible in the background. The hands carefully rotate the object to show its sleek, glossy exterior. (2) The person opens the accessory to reveal a reflective, metallic gold interior. They attempt to place a rectangular white-capped lipstick tube inside the compartment, but the object is clearly too large for the space. (3) Next, the hands try to fit a silver metal key into the same gold-lined compartment. They rotate the key and try different angles, yet the key remains too long and sticks out from the circular edge. (4) Finally, the person closes the black and gold lid, showing the closed accessory once more with its pearl-beaded strap draped over their hand. White text overlays continue to appear at the bottom of the frame.
